title: Furnace Explosion
description: Regular furnaces can smelt TNT now. Briefly.
body:
Ever wanted to **smelt TNT in a furnace** for absolutely no good reason?

This mod lets you do exactly that.

Put TNT into a regular furnace, add fuel, and the furnace will happily start "smelting" it.. until 1 tick before completion, when it explodes instead.

### Notes
- Only **regular furnaces** explode
- Smoker and blast furnace won't do the funny part
- This is a joke mod

Perfect for bad ideas, trolling friends, and teaching players not to trust industrial equipment.
